verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document an LLM or AI-agent step type inside workflows, any model selection, or in-workflow tool use. The homepage line about prompting and deploying AI agents does not tie agents to workflow steps. The MCP server serves external agents, custom Node.js code steps are a developer building block, and AI error debugging is an adjacent feature, so none of these count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can add AI agent or LLM steps inside a workflow, with model choice and tool use
